source_doc.title: 中際旭創股份有限公司 投資者關係活動記錄表 編號:2026-006(電話會議)

claims.statement: Zhongji Innolight (largest optical module maker; demand-side customer of CW/EML lasers) stated on 2026-07-12 that 2027 industry-wide 800G demand growth is more significant than previously expected — a module-maker-origin demand signal upstream of laser suppliers (Lumentum, AAOI read-through per Engine B curation).
claims.disproof_condition: If Innolight's subsequent quarterly disclosures cut 800G shipment guidance, or industry 800G orders show inventory-correction signs in H2 2026 – 2027, this stronger-than-expected demand reading is invalidated.

claims.statement: Innolight stated 2027 industry 1.6T demand remains strong and unchanged versus the previously expected volume range, with customer count increasing — corroborating the 1.6T ramp demand assumption used across CPO/optics theses from a demand-side origin.
claims.disproof_condition: If the 2027 1.6T expected volume range is revised down or customer count shrinks in later Innolight disclosures, this corroboration is invalidated.

claims.statement: Innolight stated silicon photonics (SiPh) share continues to trend up: 800G customers are further increasing SiPh ratio, 1.6T added new customers, and new customers show strong interest in SiPh solutions — supporting the rising-SiPh-penetration assumption that expands TAM for external CW laser suppliers (e.g., Sivers ELS thesis) and SOI wafer demand.
claims.disproof_condition: If SiPh ratio plateaus or reverses in Innolight's product mix (e.g., EML-based modules regain share in 1.6T), the SiPh-penetration TAM expansion assumption is invalidated.

sources.quote: 2027年800G行業需求增長較此前預期更為顯著。
2027年整體行業的1.6T需求依然保持強勁，與此前預期的數量區間相比沒有變化，客戶數量也有所增加。
硅光比例整體還是保持上行趨勢，去年主要是800G，今年800G一些客戶還在進一步增加硅光比例，此外1.6T還增加了一些新的客戶，27年1.6T客戶結構也會有更多變化，新客戶對硅光方案都充滿了濃厚的興趣。
